name: report_stage
description: Save progress for this run's approved optional stage plan. Start or complete an existing stage by ID; replan only with a full ordered plan and a reason. Notes describe work/evidence, never rename stages. Completion without evidence is saved as unverified and does not block work. Ownership is assigned by the host; do not provide runID or issueID.

stageID.description: Existing plan stage ID; required for started/completed.

verificationIDs.description: IDs of saved verification/inspection records belonging to this run.

plan.description: Full replacement ordered plan for replanned only; preserve IDs of unchanged stages.

reason.description: Required reason for a full replan.
